subject: reasoning
question: Seven people - A, B, C, D, E, F, and G - are sitting in a row. All are facing north. C is sitting to the immediate right of D, who is third from the left. How many people are sitting to the right of C?
solution:
Given: Seven people - A, B, C, D, E, F, and G - are sitting in a row. All are facing north.

C is sitting to the immediate right of D, who is third from the left.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/105052634942f5950813da6decfd55d78f5f51add1386876b7236d8e3e77ffb9.png] 

So, 3 people are sitting to the right of C.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
